component.name: CopyBoard
component.summary: Ten-chamber clipboard history for desktop workflows

description.p: CopyBoard keeps the ten most recent text clipboard entries visible in a revolver-inspired desktop interface. Select any chamber to inspect, edit, copy, or paste its contents.
A compact always-on-top widget provides quick access while working in other applications. Clipboard history remains local to the computer.
First packaged release of the ten-chamber MK II desktop app.
